scenario: PO price variance on an invoice under $5,000 (2% limit applies)
expected_result: Towel price 36.25 vs PO 34.75: variance 90.00 is under $100 but over the 2% limit (66.30). Hold; buyer query to Sofia Ramos, who approves the new price on day 1.

scenario: PO price variance on an invoice over $5,000 ($100 cap applies); late buyer reply
expected_result: Shelving price 249.50 vs PO 242.00: variance 135.00 is under 2% (184.02) but over the $100 cap. Hold; buyer query to Tom Keller. No reply by day 4: reminder cc Gregory Lin. Tom rejects on day 5 and asks for a credit; no escalation.

scenario: Invoice cites another vendor's PO; no matching open PO
expected_result: PO-26108 belongs to Pioneer Electrical Wholesale. Hold; vendor correction request to Harbor Industrial Supply. Agent finds no matching open Harbor PO. Harbor asks a question on day 3.

scenario: Partial receipt; small price difference within tolerance
expected_result: Washers billed 100, received 60: quantity variance 756.00. Bolt price difference 24.00 is within tolerance (98.18) and not raised. Hold; buyer query to Sofia Ramos, who replies that the backorder ships December 9.

scenario: No receipt posted plus a price variance; buyer redirects
expected_result: Nothing received on PO-26104 (2,130.00 unreceived), and rod price 7.95 vs 7.60 gives a 52.50 variance over the 2% limit (43.65). One buyer query to Tom Keller covers both; he redirects it to Sofia Ramos on day 3.

scenario: Invoice cites a closed PO
expected_result: PO-26105 is closed, and it is also the PO on posted invoice 008817, so the agent checks for a duplicate and finds none (different item and amount). Hold; vendor correction request to Summit Packaging. Agent suggests PO-26106 (same item, quantity, and price). Summit promises a corrected invoice by December 3.

scenario: Inventory vendor invoice with no PO number
expected_result: Inventory vendor, no PO number. Hold; vendor correction request to Summit Packaging. Agent suggests PO-26107 (both lines match). Summit promises a corrected invoice by December 2.

scenario: Resent invoice with the leading zeros dropped (possible duplicate)
expected_result: Invoice 8817 matches posted invoice 008817: same vendor, PO-26105, and 5,352.00. Agent judges it a likely duplicate. PO-26105 is closed, which fits it being billed already; no other open PO matches. Hold for AP review; the vendor email is drafted but held until AP rules.

scenario: Price variance plus a header total that doesn't match the lines
expected_result: Wire price 124.00 vs PO 118.00: variance 150.00, over both the 2% limit and the $100 cap. Header total 3,010.00 does not equal the lines (3,100.00). Buyer query to Tom Keller (approves day 2) and vendor correction request to Pioneer (corrected invoice day 1).

scenario: Exact duplicate of a posted utility bill

scenario: Rent equal to the lease amount
